Noa Borochovitch, daughter of Ludmila and Ehud, was born on 29 Sivan 5756 (16 June 1996) and grew up in Modi'in.
On 29 February 2024 she enlisted in the Israel Police and served in the Central District unit.

Sergeant First Class Noa Borochovitch fell during her service on 15 Av 5786 (29 July 2026). She was thirty years old at the time of her death. She was laid to rest in the military section of the cemetery in Modi'in. She is survived by her parents and siblings.
